purpose: Native-only requirement inventory; not an executable Interpreter scenario or evidence of a passing implementation.

cases.given: A native update callback holds ordinary ownership; a compatible whole-record writer attempts a save.
cases.expect: The writer cannot publish during callback ownership. After release, record both outcomes: success follows callback commit and saves the intended whole record; finite contention refusal reports failure and leaves the callback commit intact. An attempt announcement alone does not prove acquisition or waiting; use no fixed sleep.

cases.given: The other storage checks and original successful unrelated-progress cases.
cases.expect: Retain their assertions and accepted production requirements; do not alter runtime wait policy or mask a lost successful update.
